summary: Phase 7 P1 follow-ups verified end-to-end. Backend pytest (15/15 passed) covers full academic CRUD (campuses/departments/programmes/courses/cohorts) with audit-log writes, tenant-isolation 403s, institution PATCH persistence of ai_config + governance (with institution.update audit changes), real PDF upload with pypdf text extraction + on-disk persistence under /app/uploads, 415 on unsupported MIME, binary download with proper Content-Type, cross-tenant 403, missing-source 404. Frontend Playwright run validated: Institution Setup wizard (4 panes) saves provider=claude_sonnet + tone=academic + max_tokens=1024 + audit_level=Forensic and these values are restored after reload; Academic Structure 'New' dropdown reveals all five entity options; Campus/Department/Programme/Course/Cohort created end-to-end via dialogs and toast 'Audit log updated' confirmed; hover Row Actions menu with edit pre-fill works (edited Post Graduate Programme); Content Studio PDF upload via dialog yields a card with extracted text snippet ('TEST_UI_UPLOAD content studio Second line for extraction.'), size '1.4 KB', and a Download button that triggers a 1413-byte binary download.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 784 lines and contains models + auth + tenants + academic CRUD + audit emitters. Should be split (e.g., routers/academic.py, routers/institutions.py, models.py) before it grows further.

Academic POST endpoints require the client to send institution_id in the body even though the path already scopes the tenant; the path value is then forced onto the payload. Cleaner: make institution_id optional in the Pydantic models for create payloads, or accept entity-specific Create schemas without institution_id.

Content Studio download exposes uploaded filenames directly under /app/uploads. Consider Content-Disposition with sanitised filename plus an ETag/Cache-Control header to play nicer with CDN-style ingress.

Frontend ContentStudio shows Download for any source that has filename in DB; the three seed lecture-notes sources (no filename) correctly suppress it. Add a tooltip clarifying why some sources are non-downloadable if a non-trivial number of seed items remain.
